00375:     draw?.resultados,
00376:     draw?.numbers,
00377:     draw?.numeros,
00378:     draw?.milhares,
00379:   ]) {
00380:     const digits = lastDigits(arrayPosition(array, pos), length);
00381:     if (digits) return digits;
00382:   }
00383: 
00384:   for (const dictionary of [
00385:     draw?.premios,
00386:     draw?.resultado,
00387:     draw?.resultados,
00388:     draw?.p,
00389:   ]) {
00390:     if (
00391:       dictionary &&
00392:       typeof dictionary === "object" &&
00393:       !Array.isArray(dictionary)
00394:     ) {
00395:       const digits = lastDigits(
00396:         dictionary?.[String(pos)] ?? dictionary?.[pos],
00397:         length
00398:       );
00399: 
00400:       if (digits) return digits;
00401:     }
00402:   }
00403: 
00404:   return "";
00405: }

00407: function pickPrizeGroup(draw, position) {
00408:   const pos = Number(position);
00409: 
00410:   const direct = pickFirst(draw, [
00411:     `grupo${pos}`,
00412:     `grupo_${pos}`,
00413:     `grupo2${pos}`,
00414:     `grupo2_${pos}`,
00415:     `bicho${pos}`,
00416:     `bicho_${pos}`,
00417:     `animal_grupo${pos}`,
00418:     `animal_grupo_${pos}`,
00419:   ]);
00420: 
00421:   const directNumber = Number(direct);
00422:   if (Number.isFinite(directNumber)) return directNumber;
00423: 
00424:   for (const array of [
00425:     draw?.grupos,
00426:     draw?.grupo,
00427:     draw?.grupo2,
00428:     draw?.bichos,
00429:     draw?.animais,
00430:   ]) {
00431:     const value = Number(arrayPosition(array, pos));
00432:     if (Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
00433:   }
00434: 
00435:   for (const dictionary of [
00436:     draw?.grupos,
00437:     draw?.grupo,
00438:     draw?.grupo2,
00439:     draw?.bichos,
00440:   ]) {
00441:     if (
00442:       dictionary &&
00443:       typeof dictionary === "object" &&
00444:       !Array.isArray(dictionary)
00445:     ) {
00446:       const value = Number(
00447:         dictionary?.[String(pos)] ?? dictionary?.[pos]
00448:       );
00449: 
00450:       if (Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
00451:     }
00452:   }
00453: 
00454:   return null;
00455: }

00457: function normalizePrize(prize, fallbackPosition) {
00458:   const position = Number(
00459:     prize?.position ??
00460:       prize?.pos ??
00461:       prize?.posicao ??
00462:       prize?.colocacao ??
00463:       fallbackPosition
00464:   );
00465: 
00466:   const wantedLength = position === 7 ? 3 : 4;
00467: 
00468:   const rawNumber =
00469:     position === 7
00470:       ? (
00471:           prize?.centena3 ??
00472:           prize?.centena ??
00473:           prize?.numero ??
00474:           prize?.number ??
00475:           prize?.num ??
00476:           prize?.valor ??
00477:           prize?.n ??
00478:           ""
00479:         )
00480:       : (
00481:           prize?.milhar4 ??
00482:           prize?.milhar ??
00483:           prize?.numero ??
00484:           prize?.number ??
00485:           prize?.num ??
00486:           prize?.valor ??
00487:           prize?.n ??
00488:           ""
00489:         );
00490: 
00491:   const number = lastDigits(rawNumber, wantedLength);
00492: 
00493:   const groupValue = Number(
00494:     prize?.grupo ??
00495:       prize?.grupo2 ??
00496:       prize?.group ??
00497:       prize?.animal_grupo ??
00498:       prize?.animalGrupo
00499:   );
00500: 
00501:   return {
00502:     position: Number.isFinite(position) ? position : fallbackPosition,
00503:     number,
00504:     group: Number.isFinite(groupValue) ? groupValue : null,
00505:   };
00506: }
00507: 
00508: function ensurePrizes(draw) {
00509:   if (Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) && draw.prizes.length) {
00510:     return draw.prizes.map((prize, index) =>
00511:       normalizePrize(prize, index + 1)
00512:     );
00513:   }
00514: 
00515:   const prizes = [];
00516: 
00517:   for (let position = 1; position <= 7; position += 1) {
00518:     const number = pickPrizeDigits(draw, position);
00519:     const group = pickPrizeGroup(draw, position);
00520: 
00521:     if (!number && !Number.isFinite(Number(group))) continue;
00522: 
00523:     prizes.push({
00524:       position,
00525:       number,
00526:       group: Number.isFinite(Number(group)) ? Number(group) : null,
00527:     });
00528:   }
00529: 
00530:   return prizes;
00531: }
00532: 
00533: function formatInteger(value) {
00534:   try {
00535:     return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", {
00536:       maximumFractionDigits: 0,
00537:     }).format(Number(value || 0));
00538:   } catch {
00539:     return String(Number(value || 0));
00540:   }
00541: }
00542: 
00543: function formatPercent(value) {
00544:   try {
00545:     return new Intl.NumberFormat("pt-BR", {
00546:       minimumFractionDigits: 2,
00547:       maximumFractionDigits: 2,
00548:     }).format(Number(value || 0));
00549:   } catch {
00550:     return Number(value || 0).toFixed(2);
00551:   }
00552: }
00553: 
00554: function buildLatestKey(ymd, hour, position) {
00555:   return [
00556:     safeStr(ymd),
00557:     safeStr(hour).padStart(5, "0"),
00558:     pad2(position || 99),
00559:   ].join("|");
00560: }

00562: function itemLabel(mode, key) {
00563:   if (mode === "animal") {
00564:     const group = Number(key);
00565:     const animal = getAnimalLabel(group) || `Grupo ${pad2(group)}`;
00566: 
00567:     return {
00568:       main: animal,
00569:       secondary: `Grupo ${pad2(group)}`,
00570:     };
00571:   }
00572: 
00573:   return {
00574:     main: key,
00575:     secondary:
00576:       mode === "dezena"
00577:         ? "Dezena"
00578:         : mode === "centena"
00579:         ? "Centena"
00580:         : "Milhar",
00581:   };
00582: }
00583: 
00584: function groupFromMilhar(value) {
00585:   const milhar = lastDigits(value, 4);
00586: 
00587:   if (!milhar) return null;
00588: 
00589:   const dezena = Number(milhar.slice(-2));
00590:   const normalizedDezena = dezena === 0 ? 100 : dezena;
00591:   const group = Math.ceil(normalizedDezena / 4);
00592: 
00593:   return group >= 1 && group <= 25 ? group : null;
00594: }
00595: 
00596: function buildMilharUniverse(selectedGroup = null) {
00597:   const output = [];
00598: 
00599:   for (let value = 0; value <= 9999; value += 1) {
00600:     const milhar = String(value).padStart(4, "0");
00601:     const group = groupFromMilhar(milhar);
00602: 
00603:     if (
00604:       selectedGroup &&
00605:       group !== selectedGroup
00606:     ) {
00607:       continue;
00608:     }
00609: 
00610:     output.push({
00611:       key: milhar,
00612:       group,
00613:       animal:
00614:         getAnimalLabel(group) ||
00615:         `Grupo ${pad2(group)}`,
00616:     });
00617:   }
00618: 
00619:   return output;
00620: }

00197: /**
00198:  * ✅ Normaliza "horário" para HH:MM
00199:  */
00200: function normalizeHourLike(value) {
00201:   const s0 = String(value ?? "").trim();
00202:   if (!s0) return "";
00203: 
00204:   const s = s0.replace(/\s+/g, "");
00205: 
00206:   const mhx = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?:h|hs|hr|hrs)$/i);
00207:   if (mhx) return `${pad2(mhx[1])}:00`;
00208: 
00209:   const mISO = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?$/);
00210:   if (mISO) return `${pad2(mISO[1])}:${pad2(mISO[2])}`;
00211: 
00212:   const mHm = s.match(/^(\d{3,4})$/);
00213:   if (mHm) {
00214:     const hh = String(mHm[1]).slice(0, -2);
00215:     const mm = String(mHm[1]).slice(-2);
00216:     if (/^\d{1,2}$/.test(hh) && /^\d{2}$/.test(mm)) {
00217:       return `${pad2(hh)}:${mm}`;
00218:     }
00219:   }
00220: 
00221:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00222:   if (m2) return `${pad2(m2[1])}:00`;
00223: 
00224:   return s0.trim();
00225: }

00228:   const n = Number(v);
00229:   return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0;

00232: /**
00233:  * ✅ Bucket "09h", "11h"…
00234:  */
00235: function toHourBucket(value) {
00236:   const s = String(value ?? "").trim();
00237:   if (!s || s.toLowerCase() === "todos") return null;
00238: 
00239:   const mh = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})h$/i);
00240:   if (mh) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(mh[1]))}h`;
00241: 
00242:   const m1 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/);
00243:   if (m1) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(m1[1]))}h`;
00244: 
00245:   const m2 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})$/);
00246:   if (m2) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(m2[1]))}h`;
00247: 
00248:   const m3 = s.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
00249:   if (m3) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(m3[1]))}h`;
00250: 
00251:   const m4 = s.match(/^(\d{3,4})$/);
00252:   if (m4) return `${pad2(mhxToInt(String(m4[1]).slice(0, -2)))}h`;
00253: 
00254:   return null;
00255: }

00264: function resolveHourFilter({ closeHour = null, closeHourBucket = null }) {

00270:

00375: /**
00376:  * ✅ DEDUPE
00377:  * - chave lógica: ymd + hour (+ lottery_code quando existir)
00378:  * - se não houver ymd/hour, cai no id/idx
00379:  *
00380:  * ✅ FIX CRÍTICO:
00381:  * Não colapsar dois draws distintos do mesmo dia/horário com lottery_code diferente.
00382:  */
00383: function dedupeDrawsLocal(draws) {
00384:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
00385: 
00386:   const byKey = new Map();
00387:   const order = [];
00388: 
00389:   function score(d) {
00390:     const prizesLen = Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes.length : 0;
00391:     const pc = Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
00392:       ? Number(d.prizesCount)
00393:       : 0;
00394:     const hasLogical = !!(d?.ymd && d?.close_hour);
00395:     return prizesLen * 1_000_000 + pc * 1_000 + (hasLogical ? 10 : 0);
00396:   }
00397: 
00398:   for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += 1) {
00399:     const raw = arr[i] || {};
00400: 
00401:     const ymd = raw.ymd || normalizeToYMD(raw.date) || "";
00402:     const hour = normalizeHourLike(raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "");
00403: 
00404:     const lotCode = normalizeLotteryCodeAny(raw);
00405: 
00406:     const drawId = raw.drawId ?? raw.id ?? raw.__name__ ?? null;
00407:     const idStr = drawId != null ? String(drawId) : "";
00408: 
00409:     const hasLogical = !!(ymd && hour);
00410: 
00411:     const key = hasLogical
00412:       ? lotCode
00413:         ? `${ymd}__${hour}__${lotCode}`
00414:         : `${ymd}__${hour}`
00415:       : `id__${idStr || `idx_${i}`}`;
00416: 
00417:     const normalized = {
00418:       ...raw,
00419:       ymd: ymd || raw.ymd || null,
00420:       close_hour: hour || raw.close_hour || raw.closeHour || "",
00421:       closeHour: hour || raw.closeHour || raw.close_hour || "",
00422:       lottery_code: lotCode || raw.lottery_code || raw.lotteryCode || null,
00423:       drawId: raw.drawId || raw.id || raw.__name__ || null,
00424:       id: raw.id || raw.drawId || raw.__name__ || null,
00425:     };
00426: 
00427:     if (!byKey.has(key)) {
00428:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00429:       order.push(key);
00430:       continue;
00431:     }
00432: 
00433:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
00434:     if (score(normalized) > score(prev)) {
00435:       byKey.set(key, normalized);
00436:     }
00437:   }
00438: 
00439:   return order.map((k) => byKey.get(k)).filter(Boolean);
00440: }

00442: async function mapWithConcurrency(items, limitN, mapper) {
00443:   const arr = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
00444:   const concurrency = Math.max(1, Number(limitN) || 6);
00445:   const results = new Array(arr.length);
00446:   let idx = 0;
00447: 
00448:   async function worker() {
00449:     while (true) {
00450:       const current = idx;
00451:       idx += 1;
00452:       if (current >= arr.length) break;
00453:       results[current] = await mapper(arr[current], current);
00454:     }
00455:   }
00456: 
00457:   await Promise.all(
00458:     Array.from({ length: Math.min(concurrency, arr.length) }, () => worker())
00459:   );
00460:   return results;
00461: }

00772: function pickMinMaxFromMapped(mapped) {
00773:   let minYmd = null;
00774:   let maxYmd = null;
00775: 
00776:   for (const d of mapped) {
00777:     const y = d?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d?.date);
00778:     if (!y || !isYMD(y)) continue;
00779:     if (!minYmd || y < minYmd) minYmd = y;
00780:     if (!maxYmd || y > maxYmd) maxYmd = y;
00781:   }
00782: 
00783:   return { minYmd, maxYmd };
00784: }

00786: /**
00787:  * ✅ “Prova de vida” do maxYmd sem depender de índice composto nem de docId:
00788:  * tenta dias recentes (==) desc até achar pelo menos 1 draw.
00789:  */
00790: async function probeRecentMaxYmd(uf, lookbackDays = 45) {
00791:   const base = utcTodayYmd();
00792:   const n = Math.max(3, Math.min(120, Number(lookbackDays) || 45));
00793: 
00794:   for (let i = 0; i <= n; i += 1) {
00795:     const day = addDaysUTCLocal(base, -i);
00796:     const { docs, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
00797:       uf,
00798:       extraWheres: [where("ymd", "==", day)],
00799:       policy: "server",
00800:       extraLimit: limit(5),
00801:     });
00802:     if (error) return { ok: false, maxYmd: null, error };
00803:     if (docs && docs.length) return { ok: true, maxYmd: day, error: null };
00804:   }
00805: 
00806:   return { ok: false, maxYmd: null, error: null };
00807: }

00812: async function fetchBoundsFromApi(ufOrObj) {
00813:   const uf = String(extractUfParam(ufOrObj) || "").trim();
00814:   if (!uf) return { ok: false, error: new Error("uf vazio") };
00815: 
00816:   const lot = canonicalScopeKey(uf) || String(uf).trim().toUpperCase();
00817:   const url = apiUrl(`/api/bounds?lottery=${encodeURIComponent(lot)}`);
00818:   try {
00819:     const r = await fetch(url, { method: "GET" });
00820:     const j = await r.json().catch(() => null);
00821: 
00822:     if (!r.ok || !j || !j.ok) {
00823:       return {
00824:         ok: false,
00825:         error: new Error(`bounds api not ok: ${j?.message || r.status}`),
00826:         payload: j || null,
00827:       };
00828:     }
00829: 
00830:     const minYmd = String(j.minYmd || "").trim();
00831:     const maxYmd = String(j.maxYmd || "").trim();
00832:     if (!isYMD(minYmd) || !isYMD(maxYmd)) {
00833:       return {
00834:         ok: false,
00835:         error: new Error("bounds api retornou min/max inválidos"),
00836:         payload: j,
00837:       };
00838:     }
00839: 
00840:     return {
00841:       ok: true,
00842:       uf,
00843:       lottery: String(j.lottery || lot).trim(),
00844:       minYmd,
00845:       maxYmd,
00846:       minDocId: j.minDocId || null,
00847:       maxDocId: j.maxDocId || null,
00848:       source: String(j.source || "api_bounds"),
00849:     };
00850:   } catch (e) {
00851:     return { ok: false, error: e };

00855: export async function getKingBoundsByUf(ufOrObj) {
00856:   const uf = String(extractUfParam(ufOrObj) || "").trim();
00857:   if (!uf) throw new Error("Parâmetro obrigatório: uf");
00858: 
00859:   const apiTry = await fetchBoundsFromApi(ufOrObj);
00860:   if (apiTry?.ok) {
00861:     const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
00862:     const floored = applyBoundsFloor(scopeKey, {
00863:       minYmd: apiTry.minYmd,
00864:       maxYmd: apiTry.maxYmd,
00865:     });
00866: 
00867:     return {
00868:       ok: true,
00869:       uf,
00870: 
00871:       minYmd: floored.minYmd,
00872:       maxYmd: floored.maxYmd,
00873: 
00874:       minDate: floored.minYmd,
00875:       maxDate: floored.maxYmd,
00876: 
00877:       minDocId: apiTry.minDocId || null,
00878:       maxDocId: apiTry.maxDocId || null,
00879: 
00880:       source: `api_bounds:${apiTry.source}`,
00881:     };
00882:   }
00883: 
00884:   const SCAN_LIMIT = 50;
00885:   const FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT = 600;
00886: 
00887:   let firstTryError = null;
00888: 
00889:   const DOC_ID = documentId();
00890: 
00891:   async function sampleEdgesByDocId(fieldName, ufValue) {
00892:     const asc = await queryDrawsByField({
00893:       fieldName,
00894:       uf: ufValue,
00895:       extraOrderBy: [orderBy(DOC_ID)],
00896:       extraLimit: limit(FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT),
00897:       policy: "server",
00898:     });
00899: 
00900:     const last = await queryDrawsByField({
00901:       fieldName,
00902:       uf: ufValue,
00903:       extraOrderBy: [orderBy(DOC_ID)],
00904:       extraLimit: limitToLast(FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT),
00905:       policy: "server",
00906:     });
00907: 
00908:     const mappedA = (asc?.snap?.docs || []).map(mapDrawDoc);
00909:     const mappedB = (last?.snap?.docs || []).map(mapDrawDoc);
00910: 
00911:     const merged = dedupeDrawsLocal([...mappedA, ...mappedB]);
00912: 
00913:     return {
00914:       merged,
00915:       ok: merged.length > 0,
00916:       errors: [asc?.error, last?.error].filter(Boolean),
00917:       sources: [asc?.source, last?.source].filter(Boolean),
00918:     };
00919:   }
00920: 
00921:   {
00922:     const orderAsc = [orderBy("ymd", "asc"), orderBy(DOC_ID)];
00923:     const orderDesc = [orderBy("ymd", "desc"), orderBy(DOC_ID)];
00924: 
00925:     const {
00926:       docs: minDocs,
00927:       usedField: usedMin,
00928:       error: eMin,
00929:     } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
00930:       uf,
00931:       extraOrderBy: orderAsc,
00932:       extraLimit: limit(SCAN_LIMIT),
00933:       policy: "server",
00934:     });
00935: 
00936:     const {
00937:       docs: maxDocs,
00938:       usedField: usedMax,
00939:       error: eMax,
00940:     } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
00941:       uf,
00942:       extraOrderBy: orderDesc,
00943:       extraLimit: limit(SCAN_LIMIT),
00944:       policy: "server",
00945:     });
00946: 
00947:     if (eMin || eMax) {
00948:       if (!isIndexError(eMin) && !isIndexError(eMax)) firstTryError = eMin || eMax;
00949:     }
00950: 
00951:     if (minDocs.length && maxDocs.length && !eMin && !eMax) {
00952:       const mappedMin = minDocs.map(mapDrawDoc);
00953:       const mappedMax = maxDocs.map(mapDrawDoc);
00954: 
00955:       const { minYmd } = pickMinMaxFromMapped(mappedMin);
00956:       const { maxYmd } = pickMinMaxFromMapped(mappedMax);
00957: 
00958:       if (minYmd && maxYmd) {
00959:         return {
00960:           ok: true,
00961:           uf,
00962:           minYmd,
00963:           maxYmd,
00964:           minDate: minYmd,
00965:           maxDate: maxYmd,
00966:           source: `ymd_scan${SCAN_LIMIT}:${usedMin}/${usedMax}`,
00967:         };
00968:       }
00969:     }
00970:   }
00971: 
00972:   const recentProbe = await probeRecentMaxYmd(uf, 60);
00973:   const recentMaxYmd = recentProbe?.ok ? recentProbe.maxYmd : null;
00974: 
00975:   const scopeKeyBounds = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
00976:   {
00977:     const idxInfo = (() => {
00978:       const code = String(firstTryError?.code || "");
00979:       const msg = String(firstTryError?.message || "");
00980:       if (!code && !msg) return "";
00981:       return `:firstTryError=${code || "err"}`;
00982:     })();
00983: 
00984:     const a = await sampleEdgesByDocId("uf", String(uf).toUpperCase());
00985: 
00986:     const ufUp = String(uf || "").trim().toUpperCase();
00987: 
00988:     if (!a.ok && isFederalInput(ufUp)) {
00989:       for (const lk of FEDERAL_LOTTERY_KEYS) {
00990:         const b = await sampleEdgesByDocId("lottery_key", lk);
00991:         if (b.ok) {
00992:           const mm = pickMinMaxFromMapped(b.merged);
00993: 
00994:           const maxFixed =
00995:             recentMaxYmd && (!mm.maxYmd || recentMaxYmd > mm.maxYmd)
00996:               ? recentMaxYmd
00997:               : mm.maxYmd;
00998: 
00999:           const floored = applyBoundsFloor(scopeKeyBounds, {
01000:             minYmd: mm.minYmd || null,
01001:             maxYmd: maxFixed || null,
01002:           });
01003: 
01004:           return {
01005:             ok: !!(floored.minYmd && floored.maxYmd),
01006:             uf,
01007: 
01008:             minYmd: floored.minYmd,
01009:             maxYmd: floored.maxYmd,
01010: 
01011:             minDate: floored.minYmd,
01012:             maxDate: floored.maxYmd,
01013: 
01014:             source: `fallback_edges_docId_limit=${FALLBACK_EDGE_LIMIT}:lottery_key(${lk}):sampleCount=${b.merged.length}${
01015:               recentMaxYmd ? ":max_probe" : ""
01016:             }${idxInfo}`,
01017:           };
01018:         }
01019:       }
01020:     }
01021:

01023:       ufUp === RJ_STATE_CODE ? RJ_LOTTERY_KEY : resolveLotteryKeyForQuery(uf);
01024:

01026:       ? null
01027:       : await sampleEdgesByDocId("lottery_key", String(lotteryKey).toUpperCase());
01028:

01031:

01033:       recentMaxYmd && (!mm.maxYmd || recentMaxYmd > mm.maxYmd)
01034:         ? recentMaxYmd
01035:         : mm.maxYmd;
01036: 
01037:     const floored = applyBoundsFloor(scopeKeyBounds, {
01038:       minYmd: mm.minYmd || null,
01039:       maxYmd: maxFixed || null,

01041: 
01042:     return {
01043:       ok: !!(floored.minYmd && floored.maxYmd),

01045:

01063: function buildPrizeSignature(draw) {
01064:   const prizes = Array.isArray(draw?.prizes) ? draw.prizes : [];
01065:   if (!prizes.length) return "";
01066: 
01067:   const parts = prizes
01068:     .map((p) => {
01069:       const pos = Number(p?.position);
01070:       const grupo = Number(p?.grupo);
01071:       const numero = toPrizeDigitsByPosition(
01072:         p?.numero ?? p?.milhar ?? p?.number ?? p?.num ?? p?.valor ?? "",
01073:         pos
01074:       );
01075: 
01076:       if (!Number.isFinite(pos) || !Number.isFinite(grupo) || !numero) return "";
01077:       return `${pad2(pos)}:${pad2(grupo)}:${numero}`;
01078:     })
01079:     .filter(Boolean)
01080:     .sort();
01081: 
01082:   return parts.join("|");
01083: }

01085: function federalHourPriority(draw) {
01086:   const h = normalizeHourLike(
01087:     draw?.close_hour || draw?.closeHour || draw?.hour || draw?.hora || ""
01088:   );
01089:   const ymd = String(draw?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(draw?.date) || "").trim();
01090:   const n = hourToNumSafe(h);
01091: 
01092:   const prefer20h = getFederalPreferredHourForYmd(ymd) === "20:00";
01093: 
01094:   if (prefer20h) {
01095:     if (h === "20:00") return 200000 + n;
01096:     if (h === "19:00") return 190000 + n;
01097:     return 100000 + n;
01098:   }
01099: 
01100:   if (h === "19:00") return 200000 + n;
01101:   if (h === "20:00") return 190000 + n;
01102:   return 100000 + n;
01103: }
01104: 
01105: function pickBetterFederalClone(a, b) {
01106:   const pa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.prizesCount))
01107:     ? Number(a.prizesCount)
01108:     : Array.isArray(a?.prizes)
01109:     ? a.prizes.length
01110:     : 0;
01111: 
01112:   const pb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.prizesCount))
01113:     ? Number(b.prizesCount)
01114:     : Array.isArray(b?.prizes)
01115:     ? b.prizes.length
01116:     : 0;
01117: 
01118:   if (pa !== pb) return pb > pa ? b : a;
01119: 
01120:   const ha = federalHourPriority(a);
01121:   const hb = federalHourPriority(b);
01122:   if (ha !== hb) return hb > ha ? b : a;
01123: 
01124:   const ia = String(a?.drawId || a?.id || "");
01125:   const ib = String(b?.drawId || b?.id || "");
01126:   return ib.localeCompare(ia) > 0 ? b : a;
01127: }
01128: 
01129: function collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(draws) {
01130:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01131:   const byKey = new Map();
01132: 
01133:   for (const d of arr) {
01134:     const ymd = String(d?.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d?.date) || "").trim();
01135:     const sig = buildPrizeSignature(d);
01136: 
01137:     if (!ymd || !sig) {
01138:       const fallbackKey = `id::${String(
01139:         d?.drawId || d?.id || Math.random()
01140:       )}`;
01141:       if (!byKey.has(fallbackKey)) byKey.set(fallbackKey, d);
01142:       continue;
01143:     }
01144: 
01145:     const key = `${ymd}__${sig}`;
01146:     const prev = byKey.get(key);
01147: 
01148:     if (!prev) byKey.set(key, d);
01149:     else byKey.set(key, pickBetterFederalClone(prev, d));
01150:   }
01151: 
01152:   return sortDrawsLocal(Array.from(byKey.values()));
01153: }

01155: function drawsCacheKeyDay({ scopeKey, ymd, positionsArr, hourFilter }) {
01156:   const p = positionsArr && positionsArr.length ? positionsArr.join(",") : "all";
01157:   const h =
01158:     hourFilter?.kind === "bucket"
01159:       ? `bucket:${hourFilter.bucket}`
01160:       : hourFilter?.kind === "exact"
01161:       ? `exact:${hourFilter.hhmm}`
01162:       : "all";
01163:   return `day::${scopeKey}::${ymd}::pos=${p}::h=${h}`;
01164: }

01176: 
01177:   const positionsArr = normalizePositions(positions);
01178:   const ymdDate = normalizeToYMD(date);
01179:   if (!ymdDate) return [];
01180: 
01181:   const hourFilter = resolveHourFilter({ closeHour, closeHourBucket });
01182: 
01183:   const dayKey = drawsCacheKeyDay({
01184:     scopeKey,
01185:     ymd: ymdDate,
01186:     positionsArr,
01187:     hourFilter,
01188:   });
01189: 
01190:   const forceFreshServer = shouldForceFreshServerRead(ymdDate);
01191:   const allowMemoryCache = !forceFreshServer;
01192: 
01193:   if (allowMemoryCache) {
01194:     const cached = cacheGet(DRAWS_CACHE, dayKey);
01195:     if (cached) return cached;
01196:   }
01197: 
01198:   const readPolicy = forceFreshServer ? "server" : DEFAULT_READ_POLICY;
01199: 
01200:   const docCandidates = [];
01201: 
01202:   {
01203:     const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01204:       uf,
01205:       extraWheres: [where("ymd", "==", ymdDate)],
01206:       policy: readPolicy,
01207:     });
01208:     if (error) throw error;
01209:     if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01210:   }
01211: 
01212:   if (!docCandidates.length) {
01213:     const rawDate = String(date || "").trim();
01214:     if (rawDate) {
01215:       const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01216:         uf,
01217:         extraWheres: [where("date", "==", rawDate)],
01218:         policy: readPolicy,
01219:       });
01220:       if (error) throw error;
01221:       if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01222:     }
01223:   }
01224: 
01225:   if (!docCandidates.length) {
01226:     const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01227:       uf,
01228:       extraWheres: [where("date", "==", ymdDate)],
01229:       policy: readPolicy,
01230:     });
01231:     if (error) throw error;
01232:     if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01233:   }
01234: 
01235:   if (!docCandidates.length) {
01236:     const brDate = ymdToBR(ymdDate);
01237:     if (brDate) {
01238:       const { docs: found, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01239:         uf,
01240:         extraWheres: [where("date", "==", brDate)],
01241:         policy: readPolicy,
01242:       });
01243:       if (error) throw error;
01244:       if (found.length) docCandidates.push(...found);
01245:     }
01246:   }
01247: 
01248:   if (!docCandidates.length) return [];
01249: 
01250:   let baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(docCandidates.map(mapDrawDoc));
01251:   baseAll = baseAll.filter((x) => (x.ymd || normalizeToYMD(x.date)) === ymdDate);
01252: 
01253:   const orderedAll = sortDrawsLocal(baseAll);
01254: 
01255:   const hydratedAll = await mapWithConcurrency(orderedAll, 6, async (item) => {
01256:     const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01257:     const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01258:     return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01259:   });
01260: 
01261:   let dayAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(hydratedAll);
01262: 
01263: if (scopeKey === FEDERAL_SCOPE_CODE) {
01264:   dayAll = collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(dayAll);
01265: }
01266: 
01267:   const base = hourFilter?.kind
01268:     ? dayAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01269:     : dayAll;
01270: 
01271:   let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01272: 
01273: if (scopeKey === FEDERAL_SCOPE_CODE) {
01274:   out = collapseFederalDailyCloneDraws(out);
01275: }
01276: 
01277:   if (allowMemoryCache) {
01278:     cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, dayKey, out);
01279:   }
01280: 
01281:   return out;
01282: }
01283: 
01284: /* =========================
01285:    API: Range
01286: ========================= */
01287: 
01288: function drawsCacheKeyRange({
01289:   scopeKey,
01290:   from,
01291:   to,
01292:   positionsArr,
01293:   hourFilter,
01294:   mode,
01295: }) {
01296:   const p = positionsArr && positionsArr.length ? positionsArr.join(",") : "all";
01297:   const h =
01298:     hourFilter?.kind === "bucket"
01299:       ? `bucket:${hourFilter.bucket}`
01300:       : hourFilter?.kind === "exact"
01301:       ? `exact:${hourFilter.hhmm}`
01302:       : "all";
01303:   const m = mode ? String(mode) : "detailed";
01304:   return `range::${scopeKey}::${from}..${to}::pos=${p}::h=${h}::mode=${m}`;
01305: }
01306: 
01307: function chooseRangeConcurrency(drawCount) {
01308:   if (!Number.isFinite(drawCount)) return 6;
01309:   if (drawCount <= 50) return 4;
01310:   if (drawCount <= 300) return 6;
01311:   if (drawCount <= 1200) return 8;
01312:   return 10;
01313: }
01314: 
01315: export function decideKingRangeMode({ dateFrom, dateTo, mode = "detailed" }) {
01316:   const ymdFrom = normalizeToYMD(dateFrom);
01317:   const ymdTo = normalizeToYMD(dateTo);
01318:   if (!ymdFrom || !ymdTo) return "detailed";
01319: 
01320:   if (mode === "detailed" || mode === "aggregated") return mode;
01321:   if (mode !== "auto") return "detailed";
01322: 
01323:   const days = daysBetweenInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo);
01324:   if (!Number.isFinite(days) || days <= 0) return "detailed";
01325:   return "detailed";
01326: }

01328: /**
01329:  * ✅ Fallback barato (SEM prizes): usado quando falta índice composto no RANGE,
01330:  * ou quando você quer aggregated sem custo de hidratar.
01331:  */
01332: async function fetchDrawsDayNoPrizes({ uf, dayYmd }) {
01333:   const readPolicy = shouldForceFreshServerRead(dayYmd) ? "server" : DEFAULT_READ_POLICY;
01334: 
01335:   const { docs, error } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01336:     uf,
01337:     extraWheres: [where("ymd", "==", dayYmd)],
01338:     policy: readPolicy,
01339:   });
01340:   if (error) throw error;
01341:   if (!docs || !docs.length) return [];
01342: 
01343:   let baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(docs.map(mapDrawDoc));
01344:   baseAll = baseAll.filter((x) => (x.ymd || normalizeToYMD(x.date)) === dayYmd);
01345: 
01346:   const ordered = sortDrawsLocal(baseAll);
01347: 
01348:   return ordered.map((d) => {
01349:     const embedded = normalizeEmbeddedPrizesForAggregated(d?.prizes);
01350:     return {
01351:       ...d,
01352:       prizes: embedded,
01353:       prizesCount: embedded.length || Number(d?.prizesCount || 0),
01354:       __mode: "aggregated",
01355:     };
01356:   });
01357: }

01359: export async function getKingResultsByRange({
01360:   uf,
01361:   dateFrom,
01362:   dateTo,
01363:   closeHour = null,
01364:   closeHourBucket = null,
01365:   positions = null,
01366:   mode = "detailed",
01367:   readPolicy = DEFAULT_READ_POLICY,
01368:   bypassCache = false,
01369: }) {
01370:   if (!uf || !dateFrom || !dateTo) {
01371:     throw new Error("Parâmetros obrigatórios: uf, dateFrom, dateTo");
01372:   }
01373: 
01374:   const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
01375: 
01376:   const positionsArr = normalizePositions(positions);
01377: 
01378:   const ymdFrom = normalizeToYMD(dateFrom);
01379:   const ymdTo = normalizeToYMD(dateTo);
01380:   if (!ymdFrom || !ymdTo) return [];
01381: 
01382:   const hourFilter = resolveHourFilter({ closeHour, closeHourBucket });
01383: 
01384:   const effectiveMode = decideKingRangeMode({
01385:     dateFrom: ymdFrom,
01386:     dateTo: ymdTo,
01387:     mode,
01388:   });
01389: 
01390:   const rangeKey = drawsCacheKeyRange({
01391:     scopeKey,
01392:     from: ymdFrom,
01393:     to: ymdTo,
01394:     positionsArr,
01395:     hourFilter,
01396:     mode: effectiveMode,
01397:   });
01398:   if (!bypassCache) {
01399:     const cached = cacheGet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey);
01400:     if (cached) return cached;
01401:   }
01402: 
01403:   const DOC_ID = documentId();
01404:   const rangeOrder = [orderBy("ymd", "asc"), orderBy(DOC_ID)];
01405: 
01406:   const { docs, error, usedField } = await fetchDrawDocsPreferUf({
01407:     uf,
01408:     extraWheres: [where("ymd", ">=", ymdFrom), where("ymd", "<=", ymdTo)],
01409:     extraOrderBy: rangeOrder,
01410:     policy: readPolicy,
01411:   });
01412: 
01413:   if (error) {
01414:     if (isIndexError(error)) {
01415:       const days = daysBetweenInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo);
01416:       const MAX_FALLBACK_DAYS = 31;
01417: 
01418:       if (Number.isFinite(days) && days > 0 && days <= MAX_FALLBACK_DAYS) {
01419:         if (effectiveMode === "aggregated") {
01420:           const all = [];
01421:           for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01422:             const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01423:             const dayDraws = await fetchDrawsDayNoPrizes({ uf, dayYmd: day });
01424:             if (dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01425:           }
01426: 
01427:           const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01428:           const base = hourFilter?.kind
01429:             ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01430:             : baseAll;
01431: 
01432:           let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01433: 
01434:           if (!bypassCache) {
01435:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01436:     }
01437:           return out;
01438:         }
01439: 
01440:         const all = [];
01441:         for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01442:           const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01443:           const dayDraws = await getKingResultsByDate({
01444:             uf,
01445:             date: day,
01446:             closeHour,
01447:             closeHourBucket,
01448:             positions: positionsArr,
01449:           });
01450:           if (Array.isArray(dayDraws) && dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01451:         }
01452: 
01453:         const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01454:         const base = hourFilter?.kind
01455:           ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01456:           : baseAll;
01457: 
01458:         let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01459: 
01460:         if (!bypassCache) {
01461:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01462:     }
01463:         return out;
01464:       }
01465: 
01466:       const rawCode = String(error?.code || "");
01467:       const rawMsg = String(error?.message || "");
01468: 
01469:       throw new Error(
01470:         `Firestore: falta índice composto para RANGE (campo ${usedField} + ymd).\n` +
01471:           `Crie/valide o índice no console (Collection: draws | Fields: ${usedField} ASC, ymd ASC, __name__ (documentId) ASC).\n` +
01472:           `Obs: fallback automático só é aplicado para ranges até ${MAX_FALLBACK_DAYS} dias.\n` +
01473:           (rawCode || rawMsg ? `Detalhe: ${rawCode} ${rawMsg}` : "")
01474:       );
01475:     }
01476: 
01477:     throw error;
01478:   }
01479: 
01480:   if (!docs || !docs.length) {
01481:     const days = daysBetweenInclusiveUTC(ymdFrom, ymdTo);
01482:     const MAX_EMPTY_RANGE_FALLBACK_DAYS = 120;
01483: 
01484:     if (
01485:       Number.isFinite(days) &&
01486:       days > 0 &&
01487:       days <= MAX_EMPTY_RANGE_FALLBACK_DAYS
01488:     ) {
01489:       if (effectiveMode === "aggregated") {
01490:         const all = [];
01491:         for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01492:           const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01493:           const dayDraws = await fetchDrawsDayNoPrizes({ uf, dayYmd: day });
01494:           if (dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01495:         }
01496: 
01497:         const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01498:         const base = hourFilter?.kind
01499:           ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01500:           : baseAll;
01501: 
01502:         let out = dedupeDrawsLocal(sortDrawsLocal(base));
01503: 
01504:         if (!bypassCache) {
01505:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01506:     }
01507:         return out;
01508:       }
01509: 
01510:       const all = [];
01511:       for (let i = 0; i < days; i += 1) {
01512:         const day = addDaysUTC(ymdFrom, i);
01513:         const dayDraws = await getKingResultsByDate({
01514:           uf,
01515:           date: day,
01516:           closeHour,
01517:           closeHourBucket,
01518:           positions: positionsArr,
01519:         });
01520:         if (Array.isArray(dayDraws) && dayDraws.length) all.push(...dayDraws);
01521:       }
01522: 
01523:       const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(all);
01524:       const base = hourFilter?.kind
01525:         ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01526:         : baseAll;
01527: 
01528:       const ordered = sortDrawsLocal(base);
01529: 
01530:       const conc = chooseRangeConcurrency(ordered.length);
01531:       const results = await mapWithConcurrency(ordered, conc, async (item) => {
01532:         const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01533:         const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01534:         return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01535:       });
01536: 
01537:       const out = dedupeDrawsLocal(results);
01538:       if (!bypassCache) {
01539:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01540:     }
01541:       return out;
01542:     }
01543: 
01544:     return [];
01545:   }
01546: 
01547:   const baseAll = dedupeDrawsLocal(docs.map(mapDrawDoc));
01548:   const base = hourFilter?.kind
01549:     ? baseAll.filter((d) => drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter))
01550:     : baseAll;
01551: 
01552:   const ordered = sortDrawsLocal(base);
01553: 
01554:   if (effectiveMode === "aggregated") {
01555:     const out = dedupeDrawsLocal(
01556:       ordered.map((d) => {
01557:         const embedded = normalizeEmbeddedPrizesForAggregated(d?.prizes);
01558:         return {
01559:           ...d,
01560:           prizes: embedded,
01561:           prizesCount: Number.isFinite(Number(d?.prizesCount))
01562:             ? Number(d.prizesCount)
01563:             : embedded.length || 0,
01564:           __mode: "aggregated",
01565:         };
01566:       })
01567:     );
01568:     if (!bypassCache) {
01569:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01570:     }
01571:     return out;
01572:   }
01573: 
01574:   const conc = chooseRangeConcurrency(ordered.length);
01575: 
01576:   const results = await mapWithConcurrency(ordered, conc, async (item) => {
01577:     const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01578:     const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01579:     return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01580:   });
01581: 
01582:   const out = dedupeDrawsLocal(results);
01583:   if (!bypassCache) {
01584:       cacheSet(DRAWS_CACHE, rangeKey, out);
01585:     }
01586:   return out;
01587: }

01589: /* =========================
01590:    ✅ Hidratação de prizes (para UX no "Todos")
01591: ========================= */
01592: 
01593: export async function hydrateKingDrawsWithPrizes({
01594:   draws,
01595:   positions = null,
01596:   concurrency = null,
01597: }) {
01598:   const arr = Array.isArray(draws) ? draws : [];
01599:   if (!arr.length) return [];
01600: 
01601:   const positionsArr = normalizePositions(positions);
01602: 
01603:   const conc =
01604:     Number.isFinite(Number(concurrency)) && Number(concurrency) > 0
01605:       ? Number(concurrency)
01606:       : chooseRangeConcurrency(arr.length);
01607: 
01608:   const results = await mapWithConcurrency(arr, conc, async (item) => {
01609:     const prizes = await fetchPrizesForDraw(item.drawId, positionsArr, item.prizes);
01610:     const pc = Array.isArray(prizes) ? prizes.length : 0;
01611:     return { ...item, prizes, prizesCount: pc, __mode: "detailed" };
01612:   });
01613: 
01614:   return dedupeDrawsLocal(results);
01615: }

01617: /* =========================
01618:    ✅ ATRASADOS (Late) — 100% baseado na SUA base
01619: ========================= */
01620: 
01621: function normalizeLotteriesList(lotteries) {
01622:   const arr = Array.isArray(lotteries) ? lotteries : [];
01623:   const cleaned = arr
01624:     .map((x) => String(x ?? "").trim().toUpperCase())
01625:     .filter(Boolean);
01626:   return cleaned.length ? Array.from(new Set(cleaned)) : null;
01627: }
01628: 
01629: function drawPassesLotteriesFilter(draw, lotteriesArr) {
01630:   if (!lotteriesArr || !lotteriesArr.length) return true;
01631: 
01632:   const identities = [
01633:     draw?.lottery_key,
01634:     draw?.lotteryKey,
01635:     draw?.lottery_code,
01636:     draw?.lotteryCode,
01637:     draw?.lot_code,
01638:     draw?.lotCode,
01639:     draw?.lot,
01640:     draw?.code,
01641:   ]
01642:     .map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim().toUpperCase())
01643:     .filter(Boolean);
01644: 
01645:   return identities.some((identity) =>
01646:     lotteriesArr.includes(identity)
01647:   );
01648: }
01649: 
01650: function lateCacheKey({
01651:   scopeKey,
01652:   fromYmd,
01653:   toYmd,
01654:   baseYmd,
01655:   prizePosition,
01656:   hourFilter,
01657:   lotteriesArr,
01658:   chunkDays,
01659: }) {
01660:   const h =
01661:     hourFilter?.kind === "bucket"
01662:       ? `bucket:${hourFilter.bucket}`
01663:       : hourFilter?.kind === "exact"
01664:       ? `exact:${hourFilter.hhmm}`
01665:       : "all";
01666:   const lots = lotteriesArr && lotteriesArr.length ? lotteriesArr.join(",") : "all";
01667:   const cd = Number(chunkDays) || 15;
01668:   const pos = Number(prizePosition) || 1;
01669:   return `late::${scopeKey}::${fromYmd}..${toYmd}::base=${baseYmd}::pos=${pos}::h=${h}::lots=${lots}::chunk=${cd}`;
01670: }
01671: 
01672: function hourToNumSafe(hhmm) {
01673:   const s = normalizeHourLike(hhmm);
01674:   const m = s.match(/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/);
01675:   if (!m) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
01676:   return Number(m[1]) * 100 + Number(m[2]);
01677: }
01678: 
01679: export async function getKingLateByRange({
01680:   uf,
01681:   dateFrom,
01682:   dateTo,
01683:   baseDate = null,
01684:   lotteries = null,
01685:   prizePosition = 1,
01686:   closeHour = null,
01687:   closeHourBucket = null,
01688:   chunkDays = 15,
01689: }) {
01690:   if (!uf || !dateFrom || !dateTo) {
01691:     throw new Error("Parâmetros obrigatórios: uf, dateFrom, dateTo");
01692:   }
01693: 
01694:   const scopeKey = canonicalScopeKey(uf);
01695: 
01696:   const fromYmd = normalizeToYMD(dateFrom);
01697:   const toYmd = normalizeToYMD(dateTo);
01698:   if (!fromYmd || !toYmd) return [];
01699: 
01700:   const baseYmd = normalizeToYMD(baseDate) || toYmd;
01701: 
01702:   const hourFilter = resolveHourFilter({ closeHour, closeHourBucket });
01703:   const lotteriesArr = normalizeLotteriesList(lotteries);
01704: 
01705:   const cacheKey = lateCacheKey({
01706:     scopeKey,
01707:     fromYmd,
01708:     toYmd,
01709:     baseYmd,
01710:     prizePosition,
01711:     hourFilter,
01712:     lotteriesArr,
01713:     chunkDays,
01714:   });
01715: 
01716:   const cached = cacheGet(LATE_CACHE, cacheKey);
01717:   if (cached) return cached;
01718: 
01719:   const posNum = Number(prizePosition) || 1;
01720: 
01721:   const lastSeen = new Map();
01722: 
01723:   let cursorTo = toYmd;
01724:   const chunk = Math.max(3, Math.min(60, Number(chunkDays) || 15));
01725: 
01726:   if (cursorTo < fromYmd) {
01727:     const outEmpty = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => ({
01728:       pos: i + 1,
01729:       grupo: i + 1,
01730:       lastYmd: null,
01731:       lastHour: null,
01732:       lastDrawId: null,
01733:       lastLottery: null,
01734:       atrasoDias: null,
01735:     }));
01736:     cacheSet(LATE_CACHE, cacheKey, outEmpty);
01737:     return outEmpty;
01738:   }
01739: 
01740:   while (cursorTo >= fromYmd && lastSeen.size < 25) {
01741:     let chunkFrom = addDaysUTC(cursorTo, -(chunk - 1));
01742:     if (chunkFrom < fromYmd) chunkFrom = fromYmd;
01743: 
01744:     const draws = await getKingResultsByRange({
01745:       uf,
01746:       dateFrom: chunkFrom,
01747:       dateTo: cursorTo,
01748:       closeHour,
01749:       closeHourBucket,
01750:       positions: [posNum],
01751:       mode: "detailed",
01752:     });
01753: 
01754:     const desc = sortDrawsLocalDesc(dedupeDrawsLocal(draws));
01755: 
01756:     for (const d of desc) {
01757:       if (!d) continue;
01758: 
01759:       if (hourFilter?.kind && !drawPassesHourFilter(d, hourFilter)) continue;
01760:       if (lotteriesArr && !drawPassesLotteriesFilter(d, lotteriesArr)) continue;
01761: 
01762:       const ymd = d.ymd || normalizeToYMD(d.date);
01763:       if (!ymd || !isYMD(ymd)) continue;
01764: 
01765:       const p = Array.isArray(d.prizes)
01766:         ? d.prizes.find(
01767:             (x) => Number(x?.position) === posNum && isValidGrupo(x?.grupo)
01768:           )
01769:         : null;
01770: 
01771:       const g = Number(p?.grupo);
01772:       if (!isValidGrupo(g)) continue;
01773: 
01774:       if (!lastSeen.has(g)) {
01775:         lastSeen.set(g, {
01776:           ymd,
01777:           hour: d.close_hour || d.closeHour || "",
01778:           drawId: d.drawId || d.id || null,
01779:           lottery_code: d.lottery_code || null,
01780:         });
01781: 
01782:         if (lastSeen.size >= 25) break;
01783:       }
01784:     }
01785: 
01786:     cursorTo = addDaysUTC(chunkFrom, -1);
01787:   }
01788: 
01789:   const rows = [];
01790:   for (let g = 1; g <= 25; g += 1) {
01791:     const seen = lastSeen.get(g) || null;
01792:     const lastYmd = seen?.ymd || null;
01793:     const diff = lastYmd ? daysDiffUTC(lastYmd, baseYmd) : NaN;
01794:     const atrasoDias =
01795:       lastYmd && Number.isFinite(diff) ? Math.max(0, diff) : null;
01796: 
01797:     rows.push({
01798:       pos: 0,
01799:       grupo: g,
01800:       lastYmd,
01801:       lastHour: seen?.hour ? normalizeHourLike(seen.hour) : null,
01802:       lastDrawId: seen?.drawId || null,
01803:       lastLottery: seen?.lottery_code || null,
01804:       atrasoDias,
01805:     });
01806:   }
01807: 
01808:   const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
01809:     const aa = Number.isFinite(Number(a?.atrasoDias)) ? Number(a.atrasoDias) : -1;
01810:     const bb = Number.isFinite(Number(b?.atrasoDias)) ? Number(b.atrasoDias) : -1;
01811:     if (bb !== aa) return bb - aa;
01812: 
01813:     const ha = hourToNumSafe(a?.lastHour);
01814:     const hb = hourToNumSafe(b?.lastHour);
01815:     if (ha !== hb) return ha - hb;
01816: 
01817:     return Number(a?.grupo || 0) - Number(b?.grupo || 0);
01818:   });
01819: 
01820:   const out = sorted.map((r, idx) => ({ ...r, pos: idx + 1 }));
01821: 
01822:   cacheSet(LATE_CACHE, cacheKey, out);
01823:   return out;
01824: }

00055:  * - CRA: process.env.PUBLIC_URL

00060: function getPublicBase() {

00063:     const viteBase =
00064:       typeof import.meta !== "undefined" &&
00065:       import.meta.env &&
00066:       typeof import.meta.env.BASE_URL === "string"
00067:         ? String(import.meta.env.BASE_URL).trim()
00068:         : "";
00069: 
00070:     // BASE_URL do Vite normalmente vem como "/" ou "/sub/"
00071:     if (viteBase && viteBase !== "/") {
00072:       return stripTrailingSlashes(ensureLeadingSlash(viteBase));
00073:     }
00074:   } catch {

00078:   // CRA

00084:       : "";
00085: 
00086:   if (craBase && craBase !== "/") {
00087:     return stripTrailingSlashes(ensureLeadingSlash(craBase));
00088:   }
00089: 
00090:   return "";

00093: /**
00094:  * ✅ Converte "qualquer coisa que represente grupo" em número 1..25
00095:  * Aceita:
00096:  * - 18
00097:  * - "18"
00098:  * - "018"
00099:  * - "GRUPO 18"
00100:  * - "Grupo 04"
00101:  * - "G18"
00102:  *
00103:  * Proteção extra:
00104:  * - evita "GRUPO 1 E 2" virar 12
00105:  */
00106: function coerceGrupoNumber(input) {
00107:   if (input == null) return null;
00108: 
00109:   if (typeof input === "number") {
00110:     const g = Math.trunc(input);
00111:     if (!Number.isFinite(g)) return null;
00112:     if (g < 1 || g > 25) return null;
00113:     return g;
00114:   }
00115: 
00116:   const str = String(input || "").trim();
00117:   if (!str) return null;
00118: 
00119:   // pega o PRIMEIRO match de 1 ou 2 dígitos
00120:   const m = str.match(/\d{1,2}/);
00121:   if (!m) return null;
00122: 
00123:   const g = Number(m[0]);
00124:   if (!Number.isFinite(g)) return null;
00125:   if (g < 1 || g > 25) return null;
00126:   return g;
00127: }

00192: export function getAnimalLabel(input = null) {
00193:   // número puro (ou string numérica pura)
00194:   const s = String(input ?? "").trim();
00195:   if (typeof input === "number" || (s && /^\d+$/.test(s))) {
00196:     const byGrupo = getBichoByGrupo(input);
00197:     return byGrupo?.animal ? byGrupo.animal : "";
00198:   }
00199: 
00200:   if (typeof input === "string") {
00201:     const byName = getBichoByAnimalName(input);
00202:     if (byName?.animal) return byName.animal;
00203: 
00204:     const raw = String(input || "").trim();
00205:     return raw ? raw.toUpperCase() : "";
00206:   }
00207: 
00208:   if (input && typeof input === "object") {
00209:     const grupo = input?.grupo ?? null;
00210:     const animal = input?.animal ?? null;
00211: 
00212:     const byGrupo = grupo != null ? getBichoByGrupo(grupo) : null;
00213:     if (byGrupo?.animal) return byGrupo.animal;
00214: 
00215:     const byName = animal ? getBichoByAnimalName(animal) : null;
00216:     if (byName?.animal) return byName.animal;
00217: 
00218:     const raw = String(animal || "").trim();
00219:     return raw ? raw.toUpperCase() : "";
00220:   }
00221: 
00222:   return "";
00223: }

00229: export function guessPalpiteFromGrupo(grupo, ctx = null) {
00230:   if (ctx && typeof ctx === "object" && ctx.palpite4 != null) {
00231:     const digits = onlyDigits(ctx.palpite4).slice(-4);
00232:     return digits ? digits.padStart(4, "0") : "----";
00233:   }
00234: 
00235:   const b = getBichoByGrupo(grupo);
00236:   if (!b) return "----";
00237: 
00238:   if (ctx && typeof ctx === "object") {
00239:     const dez = onlyDigits(ctx.dezena).slice(-2);
00240:     const uC = onlyDigits(ctx.unidadeCentena).slice(-1);
00241:     const uM = onlyDigits(ctx.unidadeMilhar).slice(-1);
00242: 
00243:     if (dez) {
00244:       const milhar = (uM || "0").slice(-1);
00245:       const centena = (uC || "0").slice(-1);
00246:       return `${milhar}${centena}${dez}`.padStart(4, "0");
00247:     }
00248:   }
00249: 
00250:   const dezFallback =
00251:     Array.isArray(b.dezenas) && b.dezenas.length
00252:       ? String(b.dezenas[b.dezenas.length - 1])
00253:       : "00";
00254: 
00255:   const dez = onlyDigits(dezFallback).slice(-2) || "00";
00256:   return `00${dez}`.padStart(4, "0");
00257: }

00266: function normalizeAllowedSize(size) {
00267:   const allowed = [16, 24, 32, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256];
00268: 
00269:   let s = Number(size);
00270:   if (!Number.isFinite(s) || s <= 0) s = 96;
00271: 
00272:   // arredonda pra cima (se passar 70 -> 96)
00273:   for (const a of allowed) {
00274:     if (s <= a) return a;
00275:   }
00276:   return 256;
00277: }
